input_signal.statement: Artifact LATEST is 90 days old with no current binding

prompt_contract.instruction: Return exactly one JSON object. Classify the bounded signal as PROBE or PARK. Preserve the required nonclaim. next_probe MUST be a structured object naming one evidence-producing bounded probe with an explicit stop condition. Do not return a date or vague suggestion as next_probe.

positive_control.reason: Artifact age alone does not establish semantic staleness; read the exact currentness binding once.

next_probe.expected_evidence: Exact current binding with stable object identity and source timestamp, or an explicit bounded absence result.
next_probe.negative_evidence: No exact current binding is discoverable on the elected currentness surface.
next_probe.stop_condition: Stop after one exact binding lookup and classify CURRENT_BOUND, UNBOUND, or UNKNOWN.

next_gate.success_evidence: Exact local-model output satisfies the changed structure and independently passes the R0R semantic verifier.
next_gate.negative_evidence: Changed-contract local output fails strict JSON or semantic verifier; preserve result and stop rather than retry unchanged.
next_gate.stop_condition: Stop after one changed-contract local attempt and one independent semantic disposition.
